title: A root session's delegation wait never resumes it after the awaited delegation completes
outcome: A wait registered by termal_resume_after_delegations wakes its root session with the fan-in prompt once its awaited delegations reach a terminal state, or reports a typed failure that the session can see. It never silently strands the session.
acceptance: The cause of the missed resume for delegation-wait-81173fa2-7ac3-4a09-af54-7cb964e6a6ae (session-7284, delegation-993a6a15-6a32-433e-a191-230e600f2d1a, which completed at 22:01:30Z on host 9de63fcb) is identified from host state and logs, and recorded on this item
A regression test reproduces that cause, and with the fix the waiting root session receives exactly one fan-in prompt once the awaited delegation completes
When the resume cannot be dispatched, the wait reports a typed failure that the owner can read through its status, instead of staying silently pending
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding
